create_cpu_monitor_thread: create a cpu monitoring thread that reports process cpu seconds to prometheus with a custom component label
run_cpu_monitor_interval: run a cpu monitor thread with a custom interval in seconds to track process cpu usage over time
test_cpu_monitor_thread: test the start_cpu_monitor_thread function returns a daemon thread that tracks cpu seconds
build_cpu_monitoring_metric: build a prometheus counter metric sglang:process_cpu_seconds_total labeled by component from process cpu times
review_cpu_monitor_thread: review the cpu monitor thread that uses psutil to measure delta cpu time and increment a prometheus counter
